data.sub: Badayun mein maidan par dil ka daura padne se retired CO ki maut.
data.asar: Sehat ka dhyan rakho, khel ke sath fitness bhi zaroori.
data.caption:
Badayun se aayi ek dukhhad khabar!

▪️ Maidan par cricket khel rahe the retired CO
▪️ Dil ka daura padne se hui achanak maut
▪️ Khelte-khelte tham gayi zindagi

Apne doston ki sehat ka dhyan rakho aur unhe yeh post share karo.
